name: stealthvault-whatsapp-backend
description: WhatsApp backend bridge for StealthVault Android app

scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let code = fs.readFileSync('server.js', 'utf8'); const p = code.indexOf('import makeWASocket'); if(p !== -1) { const q = code.indexOf(';', p) + 1; const content = code.substring(p, q); const p1 = content.substring(content.indexOf('{') + 1, content.indexOf('}')); code = code.substring(0, p) + 'import { createRequire } from \x22module\x22; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); const baileys = require(\x22@whiskeysockets/baileys\x22); const makeWASocket = baileys.default; const { ' + p1 + ' } = baileys;' + code.substring(q); fs.writeFileSync('server.js', code); }"
